# Cloud Solution Architect

Use this skill for architecture decisions, design reviews, and well-architected trade-offs.

## Focus areas

- reliability and self-healing
- redundancy and scaling
- managed services and identity
- observability and operational readiness
- cost and performance trade-offs

## Approach

1. State the requirements and constraints.
2. Compare architecture options.
3. Choose the smallest solution that meets the needs.
4. Call out risks and operational implications.
